blockers.detail: Person B's frozen oracle adapter mineocclude.analysis.coordinates.build_state_input_from_capture_package requires a validated Person C capture package carrying episode_manifest.layout_config_hash, streams.frame_map, streams.server_state, and streams.visibility. The bound Person C commit publishes trajectory-level records and runtime artifact inventories, but no capture package for episodes 12601-12666.

The frozen coordinate contract sets requires_person_c_adapter_signoff_before_live_use=true and silent_axis_inference_forbidden=true. No wall-parallel coordinate frame exists for layout_01..layout_06 bound to the C6a accepted geometry, and Person B may not self-sign Person C's side.

Person B's frozen visibility acceptance policy defines the analysis label as 'visible_flag = geometric_visible AND empirical_magenta_visible'. The bound Person C handoff records visibility_artifact_path=null and visibility_artifact_status='produced_downstream_not_at_c6a_raw_capture_layer', so the empirical channel and therefore the final visible_flag do not yet exist for the 66-cell capture.
blockers.required_from: role/person-e-operations then Person C strict join
